Graduate Handbook
Our doctoral programs in chemistry and biochemistry invite independent, academically-driven students to join our diverse and supportive community of scholars and life-long learners.
Collaboration – between faculty, research scientists, fellow graduate students, undergraduates, and our interdisciplinary research partners on campus and at STEM research institutions around the globe – is at the core of our programs. Our academic environment fosters a sense of community and shared purpose among our students, research staff, and faculty.
Ph.D. in Biochemistry
Join our interdisciplinary biochemistry Ph.D. program, focusing on areas such as protein structure and function, chemical biology and catalysis, or organic and medicinal chemistry.
Learn More
Ph.D. in Chemistry
Join our program to become part of our tightly-knit community of researchers with a focus on biophysical chemistry, chemical biology, inorganic chemistry, materials science, medicinal chemistry, organic synthesis, physical chemistry, or polymer science.
Learn More
Doctoral Research
Faculty members and graduate students choose their research projects with a simple goal: to produce findings that can impact the world in positive ways.
Learn More
Research Facilities
The Jeppson Laboratory and the Arthur M. Sackler Sciences Center offer more than 50,000 square feet of research and teaching laboratories, lecture and seminar rooms, department offices, and extensive research facilities comparable to those usually found at larger institutions.
Learn More
Alumni Careers
Clark’s chemistry and biochemistry Ph.D. programs educate scholars to work in academic and professional fields.
